fields.headline: This week was exhausting, and I still had a really good parenting week. Nobody *clapped*. I'm counting it anyway.
The good stuff rarely makes noise. Showing up, listening, being *present* while running on empty.
Hard weeks have a way of erasing what went right. So I'm writing it *down*.
Being proud of yourself doesn't need an audience. It just needs you to *notice*.
What's one thing you did this week that nobody *clapped* for?
